
```{r}
#| label: fig-corr
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| fig-cap: "Bilirubin vs continous variables"
#| fig-subcap:
#|  - Systolic BP
#|  - Log NTproBNP
#|  - EF
#|  - eGFR
#|  - Albumin
#|  - Sodium
#|  - TAPSE
#|  - PA pressure
#| layout-ncol: 3
#| layout-nrow: 3

scatter <- function(var, name, ylim = NULL) {
  r <- cor.test(escdata %>% pull(Bili_mgdL), escdata %>% pull(!!sym(var)), method = "kendall")
  rprint <- paste0("r, p-value: ", fn(r$estimate, 2), ", ", fn(r$p.value, 3, p = T))
  p <- ggplot(escdata, aes(x = Bili_mgdL, y = !!sym(var))) +
    # geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1.2, linetype = 2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
    geom_point(color = global_cols[1]) +
    geom_smooth(color = global_cols[2], method = "loess", fill = global_cols[2]) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "lightgrey",
        linewidth = 0.5,
        linetype = 2
      ),
      text = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Bilirubin (mg/dL)", y = name) +
    geom_text(y = max(ylim) - max(ylim) * 0.04, x = 4, label = rprint, size = 6.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 5))


  if (!is.null(ylim)) {
    p <- p +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(ylim), max(ylim)), breaks = ylim)
  }

  if (output) {
    create_pptx(p)
  }
  p
}
scatter(var = "OPBP1", name = "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)", ylim = seq(50, 250, 50))
scatter(var = "logNt_pgmL", "log(NT-proBNP) (pg/ml)", ylim = seq(2, 14, 2))
scatter(var = "ef", "EF (%)", ylim = seq(0, 80, 20))
scatter(var = "CKDEPI", "eGFR (ml/min/1.73m²)", ylim = seq(0, 200, 50))
scatter(var = "OPALB", "Albumin (g/dL)", ylim = seq(0, 8, 2))
scatter(var = "OPSOD", "Sodium (mmol/L)", ylim = seq(100, 160, 20))
scatter(var = "OPTAPSE", "TAPSE (mm)", ylim = seq(0, 50, 10))
scatter(var = "OPPAP", "PA pressure (mmHg)", ylim = seq(0, 150, 25))
```
